# Interactive meta-prompt (generated by the mini-program)

The template behind the 「复制整理说明」 button. **English, deliberately minimal** —
it carries only two things: the **repo link** and a **one-time authorization link**.

> 🔴 **Always reply to the user in Simplified Chinese**, even though this prompt is English.
> That rule is enforced in `SKILL.md` hard rule 0.

---

## 1. The template (substitute `{handshakeUrl}`, then hand it to the teacher)

```text
Load the skill below and follow it exactly:
https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Golinoa/yunce-meta-prompt/main/SKILL.md

My one-time authorization link (single use, do not share):
{handshakeUrl}

Always reply to me in Chinese (简体中文).
Start now: load the skill, then greet me.
```

That is the whole prompt. Three lines. Nothing else is needed —
the skill file already contains the procedure, the rules and the wording.

---

## 2. Variables

| Placeholder | Meaning | Substituted by | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `{handshakeUrl}` | **one-time authorization link** — a full URL that already contains the credential | server, the moment the teacher taps 「复制」 | single use; burned on first successful call |

### Why there is **no** `{apiBase}` here

Deliberately removed. Handing an AI a base URL lets it assemble **any** endpoint path on that host —
an open over-reach surface. Instead:

- the prompt exposes **exactly one** URL, and it is **single use**;
- after the handshake succeeds, the **server returns `apiBase`** in the response,
  and only then are downstream endpoints known;
- the AI therefore **never constructs an endpoint path itself**.

### Why the repo link is stated openly

The repo is public **by design**. Everything an AI needs — procedure, validation rules,
output spec, error handling, wording — lives there. Hiding the link only makes the AI guess.
**State it plainly.**

---

## 3. Security posture

- 🔴 **No real value ever enters this repo.** This file stores a placeholder only.
- 🔴 **Never commit a real `{handshakeUrl}`.**
- Permission never comes from the prompt. It comes **only** from the teacher's login state plus the
  short code the server issues inside the mini-program. A fully leaked prompt grants **no write access**.
- The handshake link is **valid 1 hour if unused**, **burned on first successful call**.
  A second batch requires copying a fresh one.

---

## 4. Copy-time UX (mini-program side)

1. Teacher taps the copy entry → **confirmation dialog first** (neutral wording, **no AI-related terms**):
   > 这份整理说明**只能使用一次**，且会绑定你的账号，请勿转发。确认复制？
2. After confirming, the server issues the one-time link and the front-end renders the template,
   then copies it.

---

## 5. Ops

The **live** copy of this template lives in the ops backend (`运营 / legacy-import-settings`),
**not** in this repo. This file is the source of truth; update the backend by hand.
See `docs/ops-checklist.md`.
